title: One Sentence Said Out Loud in the Shop
subtitle: 滥用与防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 滥用与防范（生活与学习·健康生活与不良行为）
meta: 主题语境：滥用与防范（生活与学习·健康生活与不良行为）　|　核心词汇：abuse　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 abuse 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① abuse went on for eleven years, and everybody knew and nobody named it, and it came out in 1974 as one sentence said out loud in the shop. There was ② drug abuse in the village too, by which I mean three people and a great deal of talk about three people, and the talk did more damage than the drugs.

The ③ abuse at the home on the hill, meaning what was done to the eleven children there, was reported in 1961 and filed, and reported again in 1968 and filed, and the abuse was reported eleven times in all before anybody read it.

It was, in the end, an ④ abuse of power and not a failure of kindness, and my grandmother said the difference matters, because you can teach kindness and you cannot watch power, and no abuse, she said, survives being spoken.

The ⑤ abuse, meaning what was said and not what was done, was what my mother remembered sixty years later, and she said a word lasts longer than a bruise, and I have never been able to disagree. The man who ran the home ⑥ abused the trust of the village for thirty-one years, and nobody used the word until 1974, and after 1974 nobody used any other. He never ⑦ abused anybody himself, which is what he said in court and which was true, and which my grandmother said was the most damning thing about him: he had arranged it and not done it.

In 1989, at eighty-one, three streets from the shop, he ⑧ abused anybody who came near him, in a voice the whole street could hear, and the village let him, and my mother said that was the punishment and that it was the right one. The  abuse, meaning the whole of it, was written up in 1998 in eleven pages: eleven families were named and nine were not told. The  abuse that nobody has ever explained to me is why it took thirty-one years for one sentence to be said out loud in a shop.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 虐待；迫害；伤害
B. n. （对儿童、弱者的）摧残；虐待行为
C. n. 辱骂；恶言；谩骂
D. v. 滥用（信任、权力等）
E. v. 虐待；伤害（身体上）
G. 固定搭配：drug / alcohol abuse 药物／酒精滥用
H. 固定搭配：abuse of power 滥用职权

items.q: The abuse went on for eleven years
There was drug abuse in the village
The abuse at the home on the hill
an abuse of power and not a failure
The abuse, meaning what was said
abused the trust of the village
he abused anybody who came near him

answers.why: the abuse 意为“虐待、伤害”，这种虐待持续了十一年，人人都知道，却没有人说出它的名字。
drug abuse 意为“药物滥用”，村子里也有药物滥用，我指的是三个人和关于这三个人的许多闲话。
the abuse at the home 意为“（收容所里对儿童的）虐待行为”，指那里十一个孩子所遭受的一切。
abuse of power 意为“滥用职权”，说到底这是滥用职权，而不是善意不足。
the abuse 意为“辱骂、恶言”，指说出口的话而不是做出来的事，六十年后母亲记得的还是那些话。
abused the trust 意为“滥用（别人的）信任”，经营那家收容所的人滥用全村的信任达三十一年。
abused 是动词，意为“虐待、身体上伤害”，他自己从未动手虐待过任何人，这是他在法庭上说的，也是真的。
abused 意为“辱骂、谩骂”，1989 年他八十一岁，谁靠近他就骂谁，整条街都听得见。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这种虐待持续了十一年，人人都知道，却没有人说出它的名字。（abuse）
村子里也有药物滥用：三个人，和关于这三个人的许多闲话。（drug abuse）
收容所里那十一个孩子所遭受的一切，1961 年被举报后归档，1968 年又被举报后归档。（abuse）
说到底这是滥用职权，而不是善意不足。（abuse of power）
经营那家收容所的人滥用全村的信任达三十一年，1974 年之前没有人用过这个词。（abuse）
他自己从未动手虐待过任何人，这是他在法庭上说的，也是真的。（abuse）
answers: The abuse went on for eleven years, and everybody knew and nobody named it.
There was drug abuse in the village too: three people and a great deal of talk about three people.
The abuse at the home on the hill, meaning what was done to the eleven children there, was reported and filed in 1961 and again in 1968.
It was, in the end, an abuse of power and not a failure of kindness.
The man who ran the home abused the trust of the village for thirty-one years, and nobody used the word until 1974.
He never abused anybody himself, which is what he said in court and which was true.
